title: A Comrade Who Shook My Heart Anew

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Here I go! Water magic spell: "Amnis"! Haaah...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いくよ水流魔法
『アムニス』！
はああ……っ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Pew...
text_block_list.orig_text: ぴゅー……

text_block_list.name: Sono's Best Friend
text_block_list.text: ...Shocking. What's that, a water toy gun?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……しょぼ。
水鉄砲かよ？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: You're too harsh.
text_block_list.orig_text: 辛辣か。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh* Reality itself is harsh... I guess it's almost time to call it quits.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はあ、
現実厳しー
そろそろ潮時か。

text_block_list.name: Sono's Best Friend
text_block_list.text: So you're just going to give up on your dream of becoming a Sorcerer? ...I see. You did your best, though. Well, if that's what you've decided, Sono, then that's fine, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔導士になりたいって夢、
諦めちゃうの？
……
そっか、
頑張ってたけどね。
ま、
ソノが決めたんなら
それでいいんじゃん？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No, don't look at me as if I've finally realized something that was a long time coming. ...Well, yeah. That's right.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
やっと身の程を知ったのね、
的な顔すんなし。
……
ま、
でもうん。
そだね。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Aww, it'd be so much easier if I just gave up here. Talentless people like me don't really have the time to dream. *Sigh*, guess I'll go and find a job...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーあ。
なんか諦めたら今めっちゃ楽だわ。
才能ない奴が夢なんて、
見るもんじゃないね。
はあー、
だるいけど就職すっかー……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Such a sluggish dream... Mm. Huh? {0}-kun...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
夢だるい……
ん。
あれ、
{0}君……？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, Sono-shi! Go~od morning~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
ソノ氏！
おっは～
でござる～♪

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: I heard you talking in your sleep, that was some pretty depressing stuff... but I'm relieved to see you've woken up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんかとても切ない寝言が聞こえていたが……
ひとまず気が付いて
安心した。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Nanaka-chan and Anna-chan... Wait a second! Where's Iroha?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ナナカちゃんと
アンナちゃん……
……
あれ
待って、
イロハは！？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ahh... "Rui-chan's special magic handheld communicator"! Is that what you're using to talk from so far away, {0}...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
『ルイちゃん特製・
魔法携帯通信機』！
君はそれで遠くから話してんのか……！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I see... We were all blown apart by Maristella... Iroha is in Oedo with Ruka-chan and Eriko-chan. ...As long as she's with that reliable Ruka-chan, I guess I can rest easy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど……
うちらはマリステラさんにバラバラに飛ばされて……
イロハは
ルカちゃんと
エリコちゃんと
オーエドにいるんだね。
……
しっかり者のルカちゃんと一緒なら
ひとまず安心かな。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...So, about us, what's the situation looking like here? It seems like a forest, but... where are we?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……で、
私らは
今
どういう状況？
森っぽいけど……
ここどこ？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm? Judging from the vegetation, it looks like it's within the region surrounding Landosol... There are some trees here I've never seen before... or maybe not? It feels like I've seen them somewhere before, but maybe not... Hmmmm...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……んー？　
植生を見る限り
ランドソル圏内っぽいけど……
ちょっと見たことない木も生えてるんだよね……
いや？
どこかで見覚えがあるよーな、
ないよーな……
むむ～……？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Guess we'll have to go through the forest to know. It looks as if we're already pretty deep in it, so let's be careful not to get lost!
text_block_list.orig_text:
森を抜けてみないとって感じかな。
けっこう深そうだから、
迷わないように気を付けて行こうぜいっ！

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, let's move onwards while leaving powerful marks on the trees. ...Like this, and that... with this being the final result! Okay, it's engraved. The seal of the One-Wing is here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ
木に印をつけながら進もう。
……
こうして、
こうして……
こう！
よし、
刻めたぞ。
封印サレシ
片翼ノ
刻印が！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...That's some unnecessary quality.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……いらないクオリティ。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: *sniffle*... I'm so tired... I haven't walked this much since the Halloween FES... Can't I avoid getting sore feet for once...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふひいぃ～……
ちかれたぁ～……
こんなに歩いたの、
ハロウィンのフェス以来かも……
足棒不可避なんだが……！？

text_block_list.name: ソノ
text_block_list.text:
はあ……
待って、
あんたたち
歩くの速い……
ちゃんと出口に近づけてるのかな……？
もう100年分は歩いたわ。
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ……
待って、
あんたたち
歩くの速い……
ちゃんと出口に近づけてるのかな……？
もう100年分は歩いたわ。

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: Don't lose heart, you walk-haters!! It's okay, we'll be able to leave soon... I think! Just a little more...
text_block_list.orig_text:
へこたれるな、
アンチ徒歩共っ！！
大丈夫だ、
もうすぐ出られる……
はず！
あと少しで……

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: WHAA-...!?
text_block_list.orig_text: なぁっ！？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? What's wrong, Anna-taso?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ん？
どしたの、
アンナたそ？

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: That can't be... The One-Winged seal I drew earlier... Why is it here...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなまさか……
封印サレシ片翼ノ刻印が……
なぜこんなところに……！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Could it be that... we're back where we started...? No, no. We've gone straight ahead, haven't we...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして、
元の場所に
戻ってきてる……？
いやいや。
私たち
まっすぐ進んできたよね……？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: ...I-I suppose I'll be the one to leave a mark this time! Cutest☆Strongest☆Magical Girl Passing By☆... and here we go.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……こ、
今度は
私が目印つけるよ！
ぐうかわ☆
サイツヨ☆
魔法少女
見
参☆
……と。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...That's an unneeded self-affirmation.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……いらない自己主張。

text_block_list.name: ナナカ
text_block_list.text:
はあ……
俺さ、
この森を抜けたら
あいつに
プロポーズするんだ……
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ……
俺さ、
この森を抜けたら
あいつに
プロポーズするんだ……

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: Don't set off a meaningless death flag! ...Ugh, this is weird! We've been walking for another hour since then... Wait, this mark...
text_block_list.orig_text:
無意味な死亡フラグを立てるなぁ！
……
くぅ、
おかしいぞ！？
あれからさらに一時間近くは歩いているはず……
って
この印……

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Cutest☆Strongest☆Magical Girl Passing By☆?!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐうかわ☆サイツヨ☆魔法少女見参☆！！？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: What's going on?! This kind of looping plot... are we in some kind of light novel?! This is my handwriting, isn't it?! Yup, I wrote it on this tree, so there's no doubt about it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
どゆこと！？　
これ
ループしてる的展開、
ラノベか！？
これ
私の字だよね！？　
うん、
この木に書いたし間違いな……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: AAAHHHHH!!! Th-That's right, I remember now... This tree. I've seen it in a book...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああっ！！！
そ、
そうだ
思い出した……
この木。
本で見たことある……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: This... is an "Enchanting Demonic Tree"! No wonder we're going around in circles in the same place...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ……
『幻惑の妖樹』
だってばよっ！
道理で同じ場所をぐるぐるしてるわけだ……

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: ...I've heard stories about it, but this is the first time I've seen the real thing. Apparently it spits out miasma to paralyze your sense of direction, right? It has a clear malice to confuse adventurers and drive them to despair...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私も話には聞いたことがあるが、
本物は初めて見るな。
瘴気を吐き出して
方向感覚を麻痺させるんだろう？
明確な悪意を持って冒険者を惑わせ、
絶望に追い込み──

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: Well, it's nothing more than a mere rumor... though the fact nobody has returned to tell the tale would imply otherwise. In other words... we're also... living to just be this forest's nutrients...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
あくまで噂に過ぎないが……
戻ってきた者がいないことが
その証明。
つまり私たちも……
生きたまま
この森の養分に……

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: No! It's just a rumor, some adventurer's fantasy! To believe something like this so easily... Ugh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやっ、
あくまで噂、
噂だっ！
こんなものを安易に信じるなど……
……
うぅ……

text_block_list.name: ナレーション
text_block_list.text: ザワザワ……
text_block_list.orig_text: ザワザワ……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: *giggle*...
text_block_list.orig_text: ヒヒヒ……

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぎゃあああ～～～っ！！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, the three try to find a way to escape the forest. The canopy is so thick with leaves that they can't even see the sky. They just keep walking, but time just keeps passing by...
text_block_list.orig_text:
その後、
森を脱出するための方法を試す３人──
樹冠の枝葉が多すぎて空さえ見えぬ中、
ひたすら歩みを進めるが、
時間だけが過ぎていき──

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Hah, hii... I'm going to die. This is too harsh a punishment for the only two members in Twilight Caravan who are physically weak...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
ひぃ……
死ぬ。
【トワイライトキャラバン】屈指の体力無い勢二人には、
厳しすぎるでござるよ～……

text_block_list.name: シュテッヒパルム
text_block_list.text:
はあ……
弱音など
みっともないぞ……っ。
た、
確かに、
かなりきついが……
ソノ、
大丈夫か？　
顔色も少し悪い……
休んだ方がいいか。
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ……
弱音など
みっともないぞ……っ。
た、
確かに、
かなりきついが……
ソノ、
大丈夫か？　
顔色も少し悪い……
休んだ方がいいか。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Kh... I'm sorry... I can't do this anymore. My legs won't move. From here on out, leave me behind... continue with just the two of you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ、
ごめん……
もう無理だ。
足が動かない。
ここからは、
私を置いて二人だけで……

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: What are you saying?! It's too early for any of us to give up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何を言ってる！？　
諦めるにはまだ早いだろう！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but with this body, I'll just be dragging you two down with me. I don't want to be a burden to the youngsters... I’ll leave you my communication device, so I’m sure you two will be fine... You’ll manage to escape the forest somehow.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
でも
この体じゃ
二人の足を引っ張っちゃうからさ。
若者の重荷にはなりたくないんだ……
通信機もあるし
二人なら
きっと大丈夫……
なんとか森を脱出して。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Pass a message to Iroha on my stead, if you can. "Sorry, I don't think I can go home. Please feel free to use my body as you like. ...I've decided to give up. Take care."
text_block_list.orig_text:
イロハにも伝言お願い。
ごめん、
帰れそうにない。
私の体自由に使っていいから勘弁してよ。
……私はもう、
諦めるから、
って。
よろしくね。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I don't want us all to be wiped out. Which is why it'd be vastly better if it was just me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
全滅なんて願い下げだからね。
それなら
私一人がいない方が
絶対いいからさ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...You're right, but you know... I do want to give up. I mean, I'm aware it'll be easier that way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ん、
でもさ。
私はもう……
諦めちゃいたい。
だってその方が楽だって、
知ってるし。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: If you give up here, that's where the match known as life ends! As long as you have dreams and hopes, the future will always be bright!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
諦めたら
そこで試合終了ですぞ！？
夢と希望がある限り！　
未来は開けるっ！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Dreams, huh? Haha, so young and naive. It's been a while since I've heard that word.
text_block_list.orig_text:
夢か……
はは、
若いね。
そんな言葉、
久しぶりに聞いたよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...You see, I originally had a dream of becoming a Sorcerer. I wanted to become a cool Sorcerer who could control fire, wind and water and defeat any monster.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私ね、
元々は
魔導士になりたいって夢があってね。
炎や風や水を操り魔物を倒す、
かっこいい魔導士に。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Just so you're aware, I did my very best to make it come true, you know? Morning and night, every day... I may have even sacrificed sleep... But all that effort I put was never rewarded.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これでも一応、
自分なりには努力したんだよ？
朝も夜も
毎日……
寝る間を惜しんだこともあったかもね。
……
でも、
それが報われることはなかった。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: If talent x effort equals the probability of success... then for zero talent, no matter what you multiply it with, it’ll still be zero. Haaah... I wish I'd realized that sooner.
text_block_list.orig_text:
才能×努力が夢の成功確率だとしたら。
才能ゼロには
何をかけても
ゼロなんだよね。
あーあ、
もっと早くに気付いてればよかったな。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Which is why. Don't waste your efforts. It's easier to give up quickly... Ah, that's not something I should tell aspiring young people, is it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……だから。
無駄な努力はしないの。
諦め早い方が楽だから……
って、
若者に言う言葉じゃないか。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What do you mean? Did we skip ahead of 8 volumes or something here? Sono-shi, you're the kid here, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え、
どゆこと？
なんか
８巻くらい読み飛ばした？
ソノ氏は
れっきとした子どもじゃん？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Haha... I guess you're right. What's a kid like me even saying? ...I guess there's no need to hide it anymore.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はは……
そりゃそうだよね。
こんな子どもがなに言ってんの
って感じ？
……
もう、
隠しとく必要もないかな。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...You see, about me... I'm not a child. Iroha and I have switched bodies and minds...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……実は私、
子どもじゃないんだよ。
イロハと私は
心と体が入れ替わってて……

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: ...You're underestimating me. I already knew that. My Evil Eye isn't just for show!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……見くびられたものだ。
そんなことは
とっくに気付いてる。
私の魔眼は
節穴じゃないぞ！

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: Sono. Whether you're a child or an adult doesn't matter. What I said I didn't understand was your mindset that would accept giving up on your dreams.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ソノ。
お前が子どもとか大人とか
そんなことはどうでもいい。
分からないと言ったのは、
夢を諦めることを肯定する
その思考回路だ。

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: Whether it comes true or not, success or failure... It’s pointless to get worked up over such things.
text_block_list.orig_text:
叶うとか叶わないとか、
成功とか失敗とか。
そんなことで一喜一憂したって
仕方ないだろう。

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: A dream shouldn't be something that easily wavers! No matter how far it is, it’s the very force that pushes your own feet forward!
text_block_list.orig_text:
夢というのは、
そんなに簡単に揺らぐものじゃないはずだ！
どれほど遠くとも、
自分の足を前に進ませる力そのもの！

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: Dreams are... our very own flesh and blood!
text_block_list.orig_text:
夢とは──
血
と肉だ！

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: My... Our, Twilight Caravan's dream, is to find the phantom city known as "Twilight City", whose existence isn't even a certainty.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の……
私たち【トワイライトキャラバン】の夢は、
存在するかどうかも分からない幻の都市、
『黄昏の都』を見つけることだ。

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: But... and these are just my personal feelings speaking, I don't really mind if we don't find it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だけど……
これはあくまで私の個人的な想いだが。
私は別に、
それが見つからなくったって構わないと思ってる。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Anna-taso...? No, no, that'd be quite a big problem for us actually...
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンナたそ……？
いやいや、
それはちょっと困……

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: Of course, it's not as if I'm slacking off in trying to find it right now. But even if we don't, that'll be fine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん絶対に見つけ出すために
全力は尽くすさ。
でも、
たとえそれが見つからなくても別にいい。

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: Because I have a dream, I live everyday with my blood boiling! I have comrades who share that feeling, and Sigurd who travels with me. That's enough! I'm happy because my life is so rich!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
夢を持って、
血を滾らせて毎日を生きている！
その想いを共有できる仲間も、
旅路を共にするシグルドもいてくれる。
それで充分！　
私は
幸せだからな！！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh. Those are some nice words♪ Could you accept them as if they're also mine?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふふ。
いいこと言うじゃん♪
今の
私が言ったことにできんか？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, I totally didn't notice that you and Iroha-san had switched places, so yeah... Though it might be late... ARE YOU FOR REEAAAAAAAL?!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ちなみに
私は
ソノ氏とイロハ氏が入れ替わってることとか
まー
ったく
気付いてませんでしたけどね、
はい。
ということで
遅ればせながら……
マジでーーーーーっ！！？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Living means you can still learn things you didn't know~♪ Which is why I'm so glad to have been reborn in Astrum~!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
生きてると
まだまだ知らないことを知れますな～♪
アストルムに生まれて
よかったーーー！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Anna-chan... Nanaka-chan...
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンナちゃん……
ナナカちゃん……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...I... My dream is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私は……
私の夢は……

text_block_list.name: Sono's Best Friend
text_block_list.text: So you're just going to give up on your dream of becoming a Sorcerer? ...I see. You did your best, though. Well, if that's what you've decided, Sono, then that's fine, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔導士になりたいって夢、
諦めちゃうの？
……
そっか、
頑張ってたけどね。
ま、
ソノが決めたんなら
それでいいんじゃん？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...My dream is...!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……私の夢は……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...To watch Iroha grow into a beautiful adult.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……大人になったイロハを見ること。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I will continue to watch over my beloved Iroha as she grows... I'll support her, and give her lots of praise...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大好きなイロハの成長を、
これからも見守って、
支えて、
いっぱい褒めてあげることだ……！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I gave up then, but... This dream... This is the one dream I will never give up on...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの時は諦めちゃったけど。
この夢は……
この夢だけは
諦めない……！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は……！
……私は！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I WANT TO MEET IROHA!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: イロハに、会いたいっ！！

text_block_list.name: Anna & Nanaka
text_block_list.text: WE'LL ACHIEVE THAT!!!
text_block_list.orig_name: シュテッヒパルム・ナナカ
text_block_list.orig_text: それでいいっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Anna-chan, Nanaka-chan. Thank you. This isn't the time for me to give up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……アンナちゃん、
ナナカちゃん、
ありがとう。
こんなところで
諦めてる場合じゃないね。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Standing, she's standing! Sono-shi's standing! ...That's fine and all, but... how do we plan on getting out of this forest...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
立った、
立った！　
ソノ氏が立った！
……
のはいいんだけどぉ……
この森は
どう抜けよっか……？

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! Th-That's...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぬぐ
っ……！
そっ、
それは……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No, you're not sounding very reliable anymore. Fufu... But well, leave it to the adults from here on out. An adult who has recovered from giving up can be incredibly strong, you know!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや
そこ頼りないんかい。
ふふ……
でもま、
ここからは大人に任せとけ。
諦めから立ち直った大人は強いんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: This entire forest... I'll blow it up.
text_block_list.orig_text: この森ごとぶっ飛ばす。

text_block_list.name: Anna & Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Eh!?
text_block_list.orig_name: シュテッヒパルム・ナナカ
text_block_list.orig_text: ええ！？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry, Iroha. I had decided that I would never use it, but I'm going to break my promise. I'll borrow it for a bit...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ごめん
イロハ。
絶対に使わないって決めてたけど、
約束破るよ。
ちょっと借りるね……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Your hidden potential. Your unparalleled talent as a Sorcerer...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あんたの秘めた潜在能力。
類まれなる魔導士としての才能を……！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAAAH...!!
text_block_list.orig_text: はああああ……っ！！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Wh... What magical power...!! 7000... 8000...!? It's over 90-... Wha?! My magic measurement glasses are broken!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な……
なんて魔力……っ！！
17000……
18000……
っ！？　
魔力測定眼鏡が壊れたっ！！

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: They never had that kind of function, they're not broken!! B-But, there's no doubt that she's wielding some incredible magical power!! To think that Sono had this kind of latent power inside...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな機能ないだろ、
壊れてないしっ！！
だ……
だが、
すさまじい魔力に違いはないっ！！
しかしソノ、
こんな力を内に宿して……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I told you, it's not mine. This is Iroha's power...! That girl is a mass of potential... A power I can't control... Ah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
言ったでしょ、
私じゃない。
これはイロハの力……！
あの子って、
ポテンシャルの塊なの……
私じゃ制御できないほどの力を……
っ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Uuu?! Guuuu!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ウ
ウッ！？
ぐううっ！！

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: This is bad... Her tiny body can't keep up with the overflowing magical energy...!! ...Kh! Nanaka!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずい……
溢れ出る魔力に、
体がついていけてない……！！
……
ナナカ！！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Okay, here it comes!!
text_block_list.orig_text: よしきたっ！！

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: Our power...!
text_block_list.orig_text: 私たちの力ぁ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Take it!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 持ってけーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Ah!! My magical energy has stabilized...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！！
魔力が
安定した……！？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Like this, I can handle it...!! Let's go, Ultimate Water Magic~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これならいける……！！
いくよ
究極水流魔法──

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: AMNIS... OCEANUS!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
『アムニス・
オケアノス』！！

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAH!!
text_block_list.orig_text: はああーーっ！！

text_block_list.name: シュテッヒパルム
text_block_list.text:
はあ……
ははは、
なんてやつだ！
本当に樹海ごと吹き飛ばしやがったぞ！
さすがだ
水流のレビアタン！！
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ……
ははは、
なんてやつだ！
本当に樹海ごと吹き飛ばしやがったぞ！
さすがだ
水流のレビアタン！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I've just been given a nickname together with an unknown title... Hehe, but thank you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
知らん呼び名に
知らん二つ名付いた……
ふふ、
でもありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Thanks to the two of you, I've remembered a lot of things. ...Once everything is over, let's go have a bite together...
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人のおかげで、
なんか色々思い出しちゃった。
……
全部終わったら
ご飯でも一緒に……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: BOOOOM!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ドーンッ！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...!! Those fireworks... they're Maristella-san's doing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！！
あれは
マリステラさんの
花火だ……！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: At that height, everyone should've been able to witness them. ...Okay, we'll use that as the meeting point. Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの高さなら、
きっとみんな見えたはず。
……
よし、
あそこで合流しよう。
さあ、
行くよ！

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: Heh, you've really changed. Sono!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっ、
変わったな。
ソノ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Higyuu!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひ
ぎゅっ！？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: What is it, what is it, Sono-shi?!
text_block_list.orig_text: なになにソノ氏！？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...M-My legs... they're twitching...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、
足
攣った……

text_block_list.name: Anna & Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Ah... I see.
text_block_list.orig_name: シュテッヒパルム・ナナカ
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
そう。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thus, the three of them, having unleashed Sono's hidden magical powers and overcome the crisis, hurried towards Maristella's location at a brisk pace.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして秘められた魔力を発揮し危機を脱した３人は、
マリステラの元へちょい早歩きくらいのペースで急ぐのだった。
